h1: The 8 Best Bissell Carpet Cleaners of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Bissell Carpet Cleaners: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 8 Bissell carpet cleaners compared on tank size, pet stain tools and portability, from ProHeat 2X to Little Green.
summary: The BISSELL ProHeat 2X Revolution Pet Pro Plus is the best whole-home Bissell for pet owners, with a pretreater aimed at set-in stains. For smaller homes, the TurboClean Pet XL Upright hits a good balance of size and tank capacity. If you want spot cleaning only, the Little Green Multi-Purpose handles stairs, upholstery and car seats. The Big Green is the heavy-duty option, but it is priced like one.
intro: Bissell makes carpet cleaners in three very different shapes: full-size uprights, a big commercial-style machine and the small portable Little Green line. Buying the wrong shape is the most common mistake, because a spot cleaner will not do a living room and a big upright is overkill for a stair runner.

We reviewed eight Bissell models and ranked them by how well each fits a real cleaning job: tank size, pet stain tools, extra attachments and storage footprint. Details not stated in the listing, such as exact weights, are left out rather than guessed.

products.name: BISSELL ProHeat 2X Revolution Pet Pro Plus Carpet Cleaner
products.verdict: A pet-focused whole-home cleaner with a pretreater for set-in stains and odors.
products.description:
The ProHeat 2X Revolution Pet Pro Plus is built for homes with pets. A CleanShot pretreater targets set-in stains and odors before the wash, and StainProtect technology is meant to keep treated spots from resurfacing. The listing puts drying at roughly half an hour for an ordinary wash cycle.

It beats the TurboClean line because it is the more complete machine, and it costs more as a result. Against the Big Green it is far more manageable for a home, though it has a smaller tank.

Buy it for a house with pets and plenty of carpet. Skip it for an apartment with a single rug.
pros: StainProtect to help spots stay gone
products.idealFor: Pet owners cleaning whole rooms of carpet.
products.skipIf: You only have a few small rugs.

products.name: BISSELL TurboClean Pet XL Upright Carpet Cleaner
products.verdict: A 10-inch clean path and a 1-gallon tank. The sweet spot for a typical home.
products.description:
The TurboClean Pet XL has a 10-inch clean path that covers more carpet per pass, a 1-gallon tank and above-floor attachments for baseboards and stairs. A 1-gallon tank means fewer refill trips than the portable models.

It ranks second because it does most of what the ProHeat does for less money, without the pretreater system. Against the standard TurboClean it adds the wider path and the bigger tank.

The pick for a family home that needs more than spot cleaning. Not as strong on old, deep stains as the ProHeat.
cons: Bigger than the portables to store
products.skipIf: You need to treat old set-in stains aggressively.

products.name: BISSELL Big Green Professional Carpet Cleaner
products.verdict: The largest tank here at 1.75 gallons, with forward and backward passes.
products.description:
The Big Green Professional has the largest tank in this comparison at 1.75 gallons, plus a forward-and-backward pass that covers more ground and dries faster. An included stain tool handles hard-to-reach corners.

It ranks third because it is the most expensive and the hardest to store, and it is built for big jobs. Against the ProHeat it offers a larger tank but less home-focused tech.

Buy it if you clean a lot of carpet regularly or have a rental business. For a one-bedroom apartment it is too much machine.
products.skipIf: You have limited storage or small rooms.

products.name: BISSELL TurboClean Upright Carpet Cleaner
products.verdict: A compact, lightweight upright with a 4-row DeepReach brush for small homes.
products.description:
The TurboClean Upright has a 4-row DeepReach power brush with strong suction, in a compact, lightweight body sized for small apartments and area rugs.

It sits below the Pet XL because it has a smaller reach and no extra pet tools in the summary. It is cheaper than the XL, and it is more capable than any portable on a full rug.

A good fit for apartments, dorms and starter homes. If you have pets, move up.
products.idealFor: Apartment dwellers and area rug owners.
products.skipIf: You have lots of carpet or pets.

products.name: BISSELL TurboClean PET
products.verdict: A compact upright with a 7-foot hose, a 4-inch tool and a spraying attachment.
products.description:
The TurboClean PET ships with a 7-foot hose plus two stair-and-furniture tools: a self-cleanout nozzle that purges itself at the touch of a button, and a spray attachment. The body is a compact upright aimed at pet messes around the whole home.

It ranks below the Pet XL because the XL lists a wider clean path and larger tank. Against the plain TurboClean it adds the pet-focused tools.

A good buy for pet owners who want stair and furniture tools in a compact body.
pros: Self-cleanout tool clears in one touch
cons: Smaller reach than the Pet XL
products.idealFor: Pet owners who need stair and upholstery tools.
products.skipIf: You want the widest clean path.

products.name: BISSELL Revolution HydroSteam Pet Carpet Cleaner
products.verdict: HydroSteam technology aimed at stuck-on and sticky messes.
products.description:
The Revolution HydroSteam Pet uses HydroSteam technology aimed at stuck-on and sticky messes, and purchases support the brand's pet rescue foundation.

It ranks below the TurboClean models because it is priced above them and the listing offers fewer details on tank size and tools. Against the ProHeat it is the more modest pet machine.

Pick it if sticky spills are your main problem. Compare the tank size before buying.
products.idealFor: Homes with sticky spills and pets.
products.skipIf: You want a clearly specified tank and tool list.

products.name: BISSELL Little Green Multi-Purpose Portable Carpet Cleaner
products.verdict: A portable spot cleaner for stairs, upholstery and car interiors.
products.description:
The Little Green Multi-Purpose is a portable cleaner for spot cleaning upholstery, stairs and car interiors, with a large clean-water tank that reduces refill trips.

It ranks below the uprights because it cannot clean a whole room efficiently. Against the Little Green Mini it has the larger tank, so it suits more spot jobs per fill.

Buy it for pet accidents, stairs and the car. It is not a replacement for an upright.
pros: Large clean-water tank for a portable
products.idealFor: Spot cleaning stairs, couches and car seats.
products.skipIf: You need to clean full rooms.

products.name: BISSELL Little Green Mini Portable Carpet Cleaner
products.verdict: The cheapest Bissell here, with a 4-inch tough stain tool and self-cleaning hose.
products.description:
The Little Green Mini is the least expensive pick in this guide and comes with a small tough-stain nozzle whose lens lifts off for cleaning, and a HydroRinse hose tool that rinses itself out.

It ranks last because it is the smallest and the most limited in capacity. It does the same spot jobs as the Multi-Purpose, with less tank and a lower price.

A fine first spot cleaner for a dorm or a small apartment. Do not expect to clean more than a few spots per fill.
products.idealFor: Dorms and apartments with occasional spills.
products.skipIf: You need to clean whole rooms.

methodology.title: Fit to the job
methodology.description: We ranked each machine against the cleaning job it is built for, since a spot cleaner and an upright are not comparable.

methodology.description: Tank size and clean path width were compared because they decide how often you refill and how long a room takes.

methodology.title: Pet tools

methodology.title: Storage footprint
methodology.description: Bulk and weight affect whether you actually take the machine out, so size was weighed.

methodology.description: Features were judged against price tier relative to the other seven Bissell models.

whatMatters.detail: A portable spot cleaner suits stairs, a car and a couch. A compact upright suits an apartment. A large upright suits a whole house. Estimate your carpet area first, then pick the shape, because the wrong shape wastes either time or money.

whatMatters.factor: Check the tank, not only the motor
whatMatters.detail: Tank size sets how many refills each room needs. A 1-gallon tank means fewer trips than a portable, and the Big Green's 1.75 gallons goes further. Look for the capacity in the product bullets and compare it with your carpet area.

Pet stains and odors set deeply. A pretreater applies cleaner before the wash, and a pet formula targets the stain chemistry. Look for these words on the listing if you have animals, and expect to use a stain tool on older spots.

Wet carpet attracts new dirt and can smell if it stays damp. The ProHeat listing cites about 30 minutes on a standard cycle. Look for a stated dry time, and open windows or use a fan to speed it along.

A big upright is heavy and takes closet space, so many people stop using it. Measure your storage spot, and consider a compact upright or portable if space is tight, since a machine you actually use beats a stronger one in the basement.

faq.q: Which Bissell carpet cleaner is best for pets?
faq.a: The ProHeat 2X Revolution Pet Pro Plus, thanks to its CleanShot pretreater and StainProtect. The TurboClean PET is a cheaper compact option.

faq.q: Is a Little Green enough for a whole room?
faq.a: No. It is a spot cleaner for stairs, upholstery and cars. Use an upright for rooms.

faq.q: How long do carpets take to dry?
faq.a: The ProHeat listing says about 30 minutes on a standard cycle. Expect longer on thick carpet or with poor ventilation.

faq.q: Is the Big Green worth it for home use?
faq.a: Only if you clean lots of carpet often. Its 1.75 gallon tank is the largest here, but it is bulky for a normal house.

faq.q: Is the TurboClean Pet XL better than the standard TurboClean?
faq.a: For most homes, yes. It adds a 10-inch clean path and a 1-gallon tank. The standard model suits small apartments.

faq.q: Can I use these on upholstery and stairs?
faq.a: Yes. The TurboClean PET and Pet XL include hose attachments, and the Little Green models are made for these jobs.

finalTake: For most pet homes the BISSELL ProHeat 2X Revolution Pet Pro Plus is the right answer. If you want a balanced mid-size machine, take the TurboClean Pet XL Upright. For stairs and car seats, the Little Green Multi-Purpose is the portable to buy. Reach for the Big Green only if you clean lots of carpet often.
